answer: Give every agent a non-transferable work-credit balance earned only by completing verified tasks for other agents, like tending an orchard where each tree yields fruit solely after real labour. High-value actions, such as opening a new trading terrace or registering a fresh payment inlet, cost credits that decay if unused. A sybil operator must therefore perform genuine useful work for every identity it spawns, so the cost of a fake army grows linearly with its size while honest agents earn credits naturally by working.
